SELECT SUM(completed_races) AS total_completed_races,
       SUM(total_races) AS total_races,
       (SUM(completed_races) * 100.0 / SUM(total_races)) AS completion_percentage
FROM (
    SELECT d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, 
           COUNT(CASE WHEN r.time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS completed_races,

    FROM drivers d
    JOIN results res ON d.driverId = res.driverId
    JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE d.nationality = 'Japan' AND r.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009
    GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname
) AS subquery;

WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
)
SELECT 
    molecule_id,
    element1,
    element2,
    combination_count
FROM 
    MostCommonCombinations
WHERE

WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
)
SELECT 
    molecule_id,
    element1,
    element2,
    combination_count
FROM 
    ElementCombinations
WHERE 
    rn = 1;

WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
),
MaxCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule_id,
        MAX(combination_count) AS max_combination_count
    FROM 
        ElementCombinations
    GROUP BY 
        molecule_id
)
SELECT 
    ec.molecule_id,
    ec.element1,
    ec.element2,
    ec.combination_count
FROM 
    ElementCombinations ec
JOIN 
    MaxCombinations mc ON ec.molecule_id = mc.molecule_id AND ec.combination_count = mc.max_combination_count;

        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c

        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id

        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id

        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
)
SELECT 
    molecule_id,
    element1,
    element2,
    combination_count
FROM 
    ElementCombinations
WHERE 
    rn = 1;

SELECT 
    t.GasStationID,
    t.ProductID,
    t.Price,
    a.Country,
    a.Segment,
    a.AvgPrice
FROM 
    transactions_1k t
JOIN 
    gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            g.Country,
            g.Segment,
            t.ProductID,
            AVG(t.Price) AS AvgPrice
        FROM 
            transactions_1k t
        JOIN 
            gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
        GROUP BY 
            g.Country, g.Segment, t.ProductID
    ) a ON g.Country = a.Country AND g.Segment = a.Segment AND t.ProductID = a.ProductID
WHERE 
    t.Price < a.AvgPrice;

WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
)
SELECT 
    molecule_id,
    element1,
    element2,
    combination_count
FROM 
    ElementCombinations
WHERE 
    rn = 1;

SELECT 
    t.GasStationID,
    t.ProductID,
    t.Price,
    a.Country,
    a.Segment,
    a.AvgPrice
FROM 
    transactions_1k t
JOIN 
    gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            g.Country,
            g.Segment,
            t.ProductID,
            AVG(t.Price) AS AvgPrice
        FROM 
            transactions_1k t
        JOIN 
            gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
        GROUP BY 
            g.Country, g.Segment, t.ProductID
    ) a ON g.Country = a.Country AND g.Segment = a.Segment AND t.ProductID = a.ProductID
WHERE 
    t.Price < a.AvgPrice;

WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
)
SELECT 
    molecule_id,
    element1,
    element2,
    combination_count
FROM 
    ElementCombinations
WHERE 
    rn = 1;

sql:
WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
)
SELECT 
    molecule_id,
    element1,
    element2,
    combination_count
FROM 
    ElementCombinations
WHERE 
    rn = 1;

SELECT 
    t.GasStationID,
    t.ProductID,
    t.Price,
    a.Country,
    a.Segment,
    a.AvgPrice
FROM 
    transactions_1k t
JOIN 
    gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            g.Country,
            g.Segment,
            t.ProductID,
            AVG(t.Price) AS AvgPrice
        FROM 
            transactions_1k t
        JOIN 
            gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
        GROUP BY 
            g.Country, g.Segment, t.ProductID
    ) a ON g.Country = a.Country AND g.Segment = a.Segment AND t.ProductID = a.ProductID
WHERE 
    t.Price < a.AvgPrice;

sql:
WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
)
SELECT 
    molecule_id,
    element1,
    element2,
    combination_count
FROM 
    ElementCombinations
WHERE 
    rn = 1;

WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
)
SELECT 
    molecule_id,
    element1,
    element2,
    combination_count
FROM 
    ElementCombinations
WHERE 
    rn = 1;

sql:
WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
)
SELECT 
    molecule_id,
    element1,
    element2,
    combination_count
FROM 
    ElementCombinations
WHERE 
    rn = 1;

    SELECT
        Id,
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION(' ' IN Tags) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(Tags, 1, POSITION(' ' IN Tags) - 1)
            ELSE Tags
        END AS TagName,
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION(' ' IN Tags) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(Tags, POSITION(' ' IN Tags) + 1)
            ELSE ''
        END AS RemainingTags
    FROM posts
    WHERE OwnerUserId = 123 AND CommentCount = 0

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        Id,
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION(' ' IN RemainingTags) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(RemainingTags, 1, POSITION(' ' IN RemainingTags) - 1)
            ELSE RemainingTags
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION(' ' IN RemainingTags) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(RemainingTags, POSITION(' ' IN RemainingTags) + 1)
            ELSE ''
        END
    FROM SplitTags
    WHERE RemainingTags <> ''
)
SELECT DISTINCT TagName
FROM SplitTags
WHERE TagName <> '';

WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
)
SELECT 
    molecule_id,
    element1,
    element2,
    combination_count
FROM 
    ElementCombinations
WHERE 
    rn = 1;

WITH RECURSIVE SplitTags AS (
    SELECT
        Id,
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION(' ' IN Tags) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(Tags, 1, POSITION(' ' IN Tags) - 1)
            ELSE Tags
        END AS TagName,
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION(' ' IN Tags) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(Tags, POSITION(' ' IN Tags) + 1)
            ELSE ''
        END AS RemainingTags
    FROM posts
    WHERE OwnerUserId = 123 AND CommentCount = 0

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        Id,
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION(' ' IN RemainingTags) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(RemainingTags, 1, POSITION(' ' IN RemainingTags) - 1)
            ELSE RemainingTags
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION(' ' IN RemainingTags) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(RemainingTags, POSITION(' ' IN RemainingTags) + 1)
            ELSE ''
        END
    FROM SplitTags
    WHERE RemainingTags <> ''
)
SELECT DISTINCT TagName
FROM SplitTags
WHERE TagName <> '';

            WHEN POSITION(' ' IN Tags) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(Tags, 1, POSITION(' ' IN Tags) - 1)

        END,
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION(' ' IN RemainingTags) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(RemainingTags, POSITION(' ' IN RemainingTags) + 1)

WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
)
SELECT 
    molecule_id,
    element1,
    element2,
    combination_count
FROM 
    ElementCombinations
WHERE 
    rn = 1;

WITH RECURSIVE SplitTags AS (
    SELECT
        Id,
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION(' ' IN Tags) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(Tags, 1, POSITION(' ' IN Tags) - 1)
            ELSE Tags
        END AS TagName,
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION(' ' IN Tags) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(Tags, POSITION(' ' IN Tags) + 1)
            ELSE ''
        END AS RemainingTags
    FROM posts
    WHERE OwnerUserId = 123 AND CommentCount = 0

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        Id,
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION(' ' IN RemainingTags) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(RemainingTags, 1, POSITION(' ' IN RemainingTags) - 1)
            ELSE RemainingTags
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION(' ' IN RemainingTags) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(RemainingTags, POSITION(' ' IN RemainingTags) + 1)
            ELSE ''
        END
    FROM SplitTags
    WHERE RemainingTags <> ''
)
SELECT DISTINCT TagName
FROM SplitTags
WHERE TagName <> '';

WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
)
SELECT 
    molecule_id,
    element1,
    element2,
    combination_count
FROM 
    ElementCombinations
WHERE 
    rn = 1;

WITH AvgPrices AS (
    SELECT 
        g.Country,
        g.Segment,
        t.ProductID,
        AVG(t.Price) AS AvgPrice
    FROM 
        transactions_1k t
    JOIN 
        gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
    GROUP BY 
        g.Country, g.Segment, t.ProductID
),

ValueForMoneyTransactions AS (
    SELECT 
        t.GasStationID,
        g.Country
    FROM 
        transactions_1k t
    JOIN 
        gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
    JOIN 
        AvgPrices ap ON g.Country = ap.Country AND g.Segment = ap.Segment AND t.ProductID = ap.ProductID
    WHERE 
        t.Price < ap.AvgPrice
)

SELECT 
    Country,
    COUNT(DISTINCT GasStationID) AS ValueForMoneyGasStations
FROM 
    ValueForMoneyTransactions
GROUP BY 
    Country;

WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
),
MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule_id,
        element1,
        element2
    FROM 
        ElementCombinations
    WHERE 
        rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS most_common_combination_bonds
FROM 
    connected c
JOIN 
    bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN 
    MostCommonCombinations mcc ON a1.element = mcc.element1 AND a2.element = mcc.element2

        COUNT(*) AS combination_count

        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id

        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id

    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
),

    SELECT 
        molecule_id,
        MAX(combination_count) AS max_combination_count
    FROM 
        ElementCombinations
    GROUP BY

),

        ec.molecule_id,
        ec.element1,
        ec.element2
    FROM 
        ElementCombinations ec
    JOIN 
        MaxCombinations mc ON ec.molecule_id = mc.molecule_id AND ec.combination_count = mc.max_combination_count
)

WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    QUALIFY 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) = 1
)

    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS common_combination_bond_count
FROM 
    bond b
JOIN 
    connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id

    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN 
    MostCommonCombinations mcc ON a1.molecule_id = mcc.molecule_id 
        AND a1.element = mcc.element1 
        AND a2.element = mcc.element2;

WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    QUALIFY 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) = 1
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS common_combination_bond_count
FROM 
    bond b
JOIN 
    connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN 
    MostCommonCombinations mcc ON a1.molecule_id = mcc.molecule_id 
        AND a1.element = mcc.element1 
        AND a2.element = mcc.element2;

WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    QUALIFY 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) = 1
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS common_combination_bond_count
FROM 
    bond b
JOIN 
    connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN 
    MostCommonCombinations mcc ON a1.molecule_id = mcc.molecule_id 
        AND a1.element = mcc.element1 
        AND a2.element = mcc.element2;

WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    QUALIFY 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) = 1
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS common_combination_bond_count
FROM 
    bond b
JOIN 
    connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN 
    MostCommonCombinations mcc ON a1.molecule_id = mcc.molecule_id 
        AND a1.element = mcc.element1 
        AND a2.element = mcc.element2;

WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    QUALIFY 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) = 1
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS common_combination_bond_count
FROM 
    bond b
JOIN 
    connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN 
    MostCommonCombinations mcc ON a1.molecule_id = mcc.molecule_id 
        AND a1.element = mcc.element1 
        AND a2.element = mcc.element2;

WITH AvgPrices AS (
    SELECT 
        g.Country,
        g.Segment,
        t.ProductID,
        AVG(t.Price) AS AvgPrice
    FROM 
        transactions_1k t
    JOIN 
        gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
    GROUP BY 
        g.Country, g.Segment, t.ProductID
),

ValueForMoneyTransactions AS (
    SELECT 
        t.GasStationID,
        g.Country,
        t.ProductID,
        t.Price,
        ap.AvgPrice
    FROM 
        transactions_1k t
    JOIN 
        gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
    JOIN 
        AvgPrices ap ON g.Country = ap.Country AND g.Segment = ap.Segment AND t.ProductID = ap.ProductID
    WHERE 
        t.Price < ap.AvgPrice
)

SELECT 
    Country,
    COUNT(DISTINCT GasStationID) AS ValueForMoneyGasStationsCount
FROM 
    ValueForMoneyTransactions
GROUP BY 
    Country;

WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    QUALIFY 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) = 1
)

    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS common_combination_bond_count
FROM 
    bond b
JOIN 
    connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN 
    MostCommonCombinations mcc ON a1.molecule_id = mcc.molecule_id 
        AND a1.element = mcc.element1 
        AND a2.element = mcc.element2;

    transactions_1k t

SELECT 
    ec.molecule_id,
    ec.element1,
    ec.element2,
    ec.combination_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
) ec
WHERE 
    ec.rn = 1;

SELECT 
    g.Country,
    g.GasStationID,
    t.ProductID,
    t.Price AS StationPrice,
    a.AvgPrice
FROM 
    transactions_1k t
JOIN 
    gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            g.Country,
            g.Segment,
            t.ProductID,
            AVG(CAST(t.Price AS DECIMAL(18, 6))) AS AvgPrice
        FROM 
            transactions_1k t
        JOIN 
            gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
        GROUP BY 
            g.Country, g.Segment, t.ProductID
    ) a ON g.Country = a.Country AND g.Segment = a.Segment AND t.ProductID = a.ProductID
WHERE 
    t.Price < a.AvgPrice;

SELECT 
    g.Country,
    g.GasStationID,
    t.ProductID,
    t.Price AS StationPrice,
    a.AvgPrice
FROM 
    transactions_1k t
JOIN 
    gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            g.Country,
            g.Segment,
            t.ProductID,
            AVG(CAST(t.Price AS DECIMAL(18, 6))) AS AvgPrice
        FROM 
            transactions_1k t
        JOIN 
            gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
        GROUP BY 
            g.Country, g.Segment, t.ProductID
    ) a ON g.Country = a.Country AND g.Segment = a.Segment AND t.ProductID = a.ProductID
WHERE 
    t.Price < a.AvgPrice;

sql:
SELECT 
    g.Country,
    g.GasStationID,
    t.ProductID,
    t.Price AS StationPrice,
    a.AvgPrice
FROM 
    transactions_1k t
JOIN 
    gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            g.Country,
            g.Segment,
            t.ProductID,
            AVG(CAST(t.Price AS DECIMAL(18, 6))) AS AvgPrice
        FROM 
            transactions_1k t
        JOIN 
            gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
        GROUP BY 
            g.Country, g.Segment, t.ProductID
    ) a ON g.Country = a.Country AND g.Segment = a.Segment AND t.ProductID = a.ProductID
WHERE 
    t.Price < a.AvgPrice;

sql:
WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    tc.region,
    tc.loan_size_category,
    COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
    tc.total_count,
    (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
FROM 
    total_counts tc
LEFT JOIN 
    status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category;

SELECT s.CDSCode, s.School, 
       f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS FRPM_Count,
       f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS Enrollment,
       (f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)") * 100 AS Eligibility_Rate,
       sat.NumTstTakr AS SAT_Participants,

       sat.AvgScrWrite AS Avg_SAT_Write,
       sat.NumGE1500 AS High_Scorers,

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    tc.region,
    tc.loan_size_category,
    COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
    tc.total_count,
    (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
FROM 
    total_counts tc
LEFT JOIN 
    status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category

    tc.region, tc.loan_size_category;

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    tc.region,
    tc.loan_size_category,
    COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
    tc.total_count,
    (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
FROM 
    total_counts tc
LEFT JOIN 
    status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
ORDER BY 
    tc.region, tc.loan_size_category;

        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id

    GROUP BY

    (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c

        COUNT(*) AS loan_count

        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (

        region,

        loan_count AS c_count

        loan_counts

),

)

    COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,

    (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c

sql:
WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
successful_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS successful_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_success AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(s.successful_count, 0) / t.total_count * 100 AS success_percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    LEFT JOIN 
        successful_loans s ON t.region = s.region AND t.loan_size_category = s.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(success_percentage) AS overall_avg_percentage
    FROM 
        percentage_success
)
SELECT 
    p.region,
    p.loan_size_category,
    p.success_percentage,
    o.overall_avg_percentage,
    p.success_percentage - o.overall_avg_percentage AS difference_from_avg
FROM 
    percentage_success p, overall_average o;

SELECT 
    ec.molecule_id,
    ec.element1,
    ec.element2,
    ec.combination_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
) ec
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        MAX(combination_count) AS max_combination_count
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            m.molecule_id,
            a1.element AS element1,
            a2.element AS element2,
            COUNT(*) AS combination_count
        FROM 
            connected c
        JOIN 
            atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
        JOIN 
            atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
        JOIN 
            molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
        WHERE 
            a1.element < a2.element
        GROUP BY 
            m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    ) sub
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id
) max_ec ON ec.molecule_id = max_ec.molecule_id AND ec.combination_count = max_ec.max_combination_count;

        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    tc.region,
    tc.loan_size_category,
    COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
    tc.total_count,
    (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
FROM 
    total_counts tc
LEFT JOIN 
    status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category;

    g.GasStationID,
    t.ProductID,
    t.Price AS StationPrice,
    a.AvgPrice
FROM 
    transactions_1k t
JOIN

        SELECT 
            g.Country,
            g.Segment,
            t.ProductID,
            AVG(CAST(t.Price AS DECIMAL(18, 6))) AS AvgPrice

            gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
        GROUP BY

WHERE 
    t.Price < a.AvgPrice;

SELECT 
    ec.molecule_id,
    ec.element1,
    ec.element2,
    ec.combination_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
) ec
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        MAX(combination_count) AS max_combination_count
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            m.molecule_id,
            a1.element AS element1,
            a2.element AS element2,
            COUNT(*) AS combination_count
        FROM 
            connected c
        JOIN 
            atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
        JOIN 
            atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
        JOIN 
            molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
        WHERE 
            a1.element < a2.element
        GROUP BY 
            m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    ) sub
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id
) max_ec ON ec.molecule_id = max_ec.molecule_id AND ec.combination_count = max_ec.max_combination_count;

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    tc.region,
    tc.loan_size_category,
    COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
    tc.total_count,
    (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
FROM 
    total_counts tc
LEFT JOIN 
    status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category;

SELECT 
    g.Country,
    g.GasStationID,
    t.ProductID,
    t.Price AS StationPrice,
    a.AvgPrice
FROM 
    transactions_1k t
JOIN 
    gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            g.Country,
            g.Segment,
            t.ProductID,
            AVG(CAST(t.Price AS DECIMAL(18, 6))) AS AvgPrice
        FROM 
            transactions_1k t
        JOIN 
            gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
        GROUP BY 
            g.Country, g.Segment, t.ProductID
    ) a ON g.Country = a.Country AND g.Segment = a.Segment AND t.ProductID = a.ProductID
WHERE 
    t.Price < a.AvgPrice;

    ec.element1,
    ec.element2,
    ec.combination_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN

    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
) ec
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        MAX(combination_count) AS max_combination_count
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            m.molecule_id,
            a1.element AS element1,
            a2.element AS element2,
            COUNT(*) AS combination_count
        FROM 
            connected c
        JOIN 
            atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
        JOIN 
            atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
        JOIN

        WHERE

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    tc.region,
    tc.loan_size_category,
    COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
    tc.total_count,
    (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
FROM 
    total_counts tc
LEFT JOIN 
    status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category;

sql:
WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
),
MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule_id,
        element1,
        element2
    FROM 
        ElementCombinations
    WHERE 
        rn = 1
),
MostCommonCombinationBonds AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS most_common_combination_bonds
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        MostCommonCombinations mcc ON a1.element = mcc.element1 AND a2.element = mcc.element2
),
TotalBonds AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS total_bonds
    FROM 
        bond
)
SELECT 
    (most_common_combination_bonds * 100.0 / total_bonds) AS percentage
FROM 
    MostCommonCombinationBonds, TotalBonds;

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    LEFT JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
FROM 
    percentage_c;

WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    QUALIFY 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) = 1
),
CommonCombinationBondCount AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(b.bond_id) AS common_combination_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond b
    JOIN 
        connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        MostCommonCombinations mcc ON a1.molecule_id = mcc.molecule_id 
            AND a1.element = mcc.element1 
            AND a2.element = mcc.element2
),
TotalBondCount AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(bond_id) AS total_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond
)
SELECT 
    (common_combination_bond_count * 100.0 / total_bond_count) AS percentage
FROM 
    CommonCombinationBondCount, TotalBondCount;

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    LEFT JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
FROM 
    percentage_c;

        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    QUALIFY 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) = 1
),
CommonCombinationBondCount AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS common_combination_bond_count

        bond b

        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        MostCommonCombinations mcc ON a1.molecule_id = mcc.molecule_id 
            AND a1.element = mcc.element1 
            AND a2.element = mcc.element2
),
TotalBondCount AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond
)
SELECT 
    (common_combination_bond_count * 100.0 / total_bond_count) AS percentage
FROM

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    LEFT JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
FROM 
    percentage_c;

sql:
WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
successful_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS successful_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_success AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(s.successful_count, 0) / t.total_count * 100 AS success_percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    LEFT JOIN 
        successful_loans s ON t.region = s.region AND t.loan_size_category = s.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(success_percentage) AS overall_avg_percentage
    FROM 
        percentage_success
)
SELECT 
    p.region,
    p.loan_size_category,
    p.success_percentage,
    o.overall_avg_percentage,
    p.success_percentage - o.overall_avg_percentage AS difference_from_avg
FROM 
    percentage_success p, overall_average o;

WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    QUALIFY 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) = 1
),
CommonCombinationBondCount AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS common_combination_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond b
    JOIN 
        connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        MostCommonCombinations mcc ON a1.molecule_id = mcc.molecule_id 
            AND a1.element = mcc.element1 
            AND a2.element = mcc.element2
),
TotalBondCount AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond
)
SELECT 
    (common_combination_bond_count * 100.0 / total_bond_count) AS percentage
FROM 
    CommonCombinationBondCount, TotalBondCount;

WITH AvgPrices AS (
    SELECT 
        g.Country,
        g.Segment,
        t.ProductID,
        AVG(CAST(t.Price AS DECIMAL(18, 6))) AS AvgPrice
    FROM 
        transactions_1k t
    JOIN 
        gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
    GROUP BY 
        g.Country, g.Segment, t.ProductID
)

    g.Country,
    g.GasStationID
FROM 
    transactions_1k t
JOIN 
    gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
JOIN 
    AvgPrices a ON g.Country = a.Country AND g.Segment = a.Segment AND t.ProductID = a.ProductID
WHERE 
    t.Price < a.AvgPrice
GROUP BY 
    g.Country, g.GasStationID;

SELECT 
    ec.molecule_id,
    ec.element1,
    ec.element2,
    ec.combination_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
) ec
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        sub.molecule_id,
        MAX(sub.combination_count) AS max_combination_count
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            m.molecule_id,
            a1.element AS element1,
            a2.element AS element2,
            COUNT(*) AS combination_count
        FROM 
            connected c
        JOIN 
            atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
        JOIN 
            atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
        JOIN 
            molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
        WHERE 
            a1.element < a2.element
        GROUP BY 
            m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    ) sub
    GROUP BY 
        sub.molecule_id
) max_ec ON ec.molecule_id = max_ec.molecule_id AND ec.combination_count = max_ec.max_combination_count;

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS avg_single_bonds
FROM (
    SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS single_bond_count
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'
    AND b.bond_type = '-'
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
) AS subquery
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM molecule m
    WHERE m.molecule_id = subquery.molecule_id
    AND m.label = '+'
);

SELECT 
    ec.molecule_id,
    ec.element1,
    ec.element2,
    ec.combination_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
) ec
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        sub.molecule_id,
        MAX(sub.combination_count) AS max_combination_count
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            m.molecule_id,
            a1.element AS element1,
            a2.element AS element2,
            COUNT(*) AS combination_count
        FROM 
            connected c
        JOIN 
            atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
        JOIN 
            atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
        JOIN 
            molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
        WHERE 
            a1.element < a2.element
        GROUP BY 
            m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    ) sub
    GROUP BY 
        sub.molecule_id
) max_ec ON ec.molecule_id = max_ec.molecule_id AND ec.combination_count = max_ec.max_combination_count;

sql:
WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    LEFT JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
    WHERE 
        sc.region IS NULL
)
SELECT 
    pc.region,
    pc.loan_size_category,
    pc.percentage_c,
    (SELECT AVG(percentage_c) FROM percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c,
    pc.percentage_c - (SELECT AVG(percentage_c) FROM percentage_c) AS difference_from_average
FROM 
    percentage_c pc
ORDER BY 
    pc.region, pc.loan_size_category;

    FROM

    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN

        JOIN

        WHERE 
            a1.element < a2.element
        GROUP BY 
            m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    ) sub
    GROUP BY

sql:
WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    LEFT JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
    WHERE 
        sc.region IS NULL
)
SELECT 
    pc.region,
    pc.loan_size_category,
    pc.percentage_c,
    (SELECT AVG(percentage_c) FROM percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c,
    pc.percentage_c - (SELECT AVG(percentage_c) FROM percentage_c) AS difference_from_average
FROM 
    percentage_c pc
ORDER BY 
    pc.region, pc.loan_size_category;

    SELECT 
        g.Country,
        g.Segment,
        t.ProductID,
        AVG(CAST(t.Price AS DECIMAL(18, 6))) AS AvgPrice
    FROM 
        transactions_1k t
    JOIN 
        gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
    GROUP BY 
        g.Country, g.Segment, t.ProductID
)

    g.Country,
    g.GasStationID
FROM

    gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID

    AvgPrices a ON g.Country = a.Country AND g.Segment = a.Segment AND t.ProductID = a.ProductID
WHERE 
    t.Price < a.AvgPrice
GROUP BY 
    g.Country, g.GasStationID;

SELECT 
    ec.molecule_id,
    ec.element1,
    ec.element2,
    ec.combination_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
) ec
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        sub.molecule_id,
        MAX(sub.combination_count) AS max_combination_count
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            m.molecule_id,
            a1.element AS element1,
            a2.element AS element2,
            COUNT(*) AS combination_count
        FROM 
            connected c
        JOIN 
            atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
        JOIN 
            atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
        JOIN 
            molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
        WHERE 
            a1.element < a2.element
        GROUP BY 
            m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    ) sub
    GROUP BY 
        sub.molecule_id
) max_ec ON ec.molecule_id = max_ec.molecule_id AND ec.combination_count = max_ec.max_combination_count;

sql:
WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM

sql:
WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
),
MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule_id,
        element1,
        element2
    FROM 
        ElementCombinations
    WHERE 
        rn = 1
),
MostCommonCombinationBonds AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS most_common_combination_bonds
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        MostCommonCombinations mcc ON a1.element = mcc.element1 AND a2.element = mcc.element2
),
TotalBonds AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS total_bonds
    FROM 
        bond
)
SELECT 
    (most_common_combination_bonds * 100.0 / total_bonds) AS percentage
FROM 
    MostCommonCombinationBonds, TotalBonds;

    FROM 
        bond b
    JOIN 
        connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    JOIN 
        (SELECT 
            ec.molecule_id,
            ec.element1,
            ec.element2
         FROM 
            (SELECT 
                m.molecule_id,
                a1.element AS element1,
                a2.element AS element2,
                COUNT(*) AS combination_count
             FROM 
                connected c
             JOIN 
                atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
             JOIN 
                atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
             JOIN 
                molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

                a1.element < a2.element
             GROUP BY 
                m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element) ec
         JOIN 
            (SELECT 
                molecule_id,
                MAX(combination_count) AS max_combination_count
             FROM 
                (SELECT 
                    m.molecule_id,
                    a1.element AS element1,

                    connected c

                    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id

                    molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
                 WHERE 
                    a1.element < a2.element

                    m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element) ec

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,

        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c

    FROM

WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    QUALIFY 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) = 1
),
CommonCombinationBondCount AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS common_combination_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond b
    JOIN 
        connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        MostCommonCombinations mcc ON a1.molecule_id = mcc.molecule_id 
            AND a1.element = mcc.element1 
            AND a2.element = mcc.element2
),
TotalBondCount AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond
)
SELECT 
    (common_combination_bond_count * 100.0 / total_bond_count) AS percentage
FROM 
    CommonCombinationBondCount, TotalBondCount;

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
successful_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS successful_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_success AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(s.successful_count, 0) / t.total_count * 100 AS success_percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    LEFT JOIN 
        successful_loans s ON t.region = s.region AND t.loan_size_category = s.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(success_percentage) AS overall_avg_percentage
    FROM 
        percentage_success
)
SELECT 
    p.region,
    p.loan_size_category,
    p.success_percentage,
    o.overall_avg_percentage,
    p.success_percentage - o.overall_avg_percentage AS difference_from_avg
FROM 
    percentage_success p, overall_average o;

WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    QUALIFY 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) = 1
),
CommonCombinationBondCount AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS common_combination_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond b
    JOIN 
        connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        MostCommonCombinations mcc ON a1.molecule_id = mcc.molecule_id 
            AND a1.element = mcc.element1 
            AND a2.element = mcc.element2
),
TotalBondCount AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond
)
SELECT 
    (common_combination_bond_count * 100.0 / total_bond_count) AS percentage
FROM 
    CommonCombinationBondCount, TotalBondCount;

sql:
WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
aggregated_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN loan_count ELSE 0 END) AS c_count,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG((c_count * 100.0) / total_count) AS overall_avg_percentage_c
    FROM 
        aggregated_counts
    WHERE 
        total_count > 0

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
aggregated_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN loan_count ELSE 0 END) AS c_count,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG((c_count * 100.0) / total_count) AS overall_avg_percentage_c
    FROM 
        aggregated_counts
    WHERE 
        total_count > 0
)
SELECT 
    ac.region,
    ac.loan_size_category,
    (ac.c_count * 100.0 / ac.total_count) AS percentage_c,
    oa.overall_avg_percentage_c,
    (ac.c_count * 100.0 / ac.total_count) - oa.overall_avg_percentage_c AS difference_from_average
FROM 
    aggregated_counts ac
CROSS JOIN 
    overall_average oa
WHERE 
    ac.total_count > 0
ORDER BY 
    ac.region, ac.loan_size_category;

sql:
WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
aggregated_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN loan_count ELSE 0 END) AS c_count,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG((c_count * 100.0) / total_count) AS overall_avg_percentage_c
    FROM 
        aggregated_counts
    WHERE 
        total_count > 0
)
SELECT 
    ac.region,
    ac.loan_size_category,
    (ac.c_count * 100.0 / ac.total_count) AS percentage_c,
    oa.overall_avg_percentage_c,
    (ac.c_count * 100.0 / ac.total_count) - oa.overall_avg_percentage_c AS difference_from_average
FROM 
    aggregated_counts ac
CROSS JOIN 
    overall_average oa
WHERE 
    ac.total_count > 0
ORDER BY 
    ac.region, ac.loan_size_category;

sql:
WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
aggregated_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN loan_count ELSE 0 END) AS c_count,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG((c_count * 100.0) / total_count) AS overall_avg_percentage_c
    FROM 
        aggregated_counts
    WHERE 
        total_count > 0
)
SELECT 
    ac.region,
    ac.loan_size_category,
    (ac.c_count * 100.0 / ac.total_count) AS percentage_c,
    oa.overall_avg_percentage_c,
    (ac.c_count * 100.0 / ac.total_count) - oa.overall_avg_percentage_c AS difference_from_average
FROM 
    aggregated_counts ac
CROSS JOIN 
    overall_average oa
WHERE 
    ac.total_count > 0
ORDER BY 
    ac.region, ac.loan_size_category;

)

sql:
WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    LEFT JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
    FROM 
        percentage_c
)
SELECT 
    pc.region,
    pc.loan_size_category,
    pc.percentage_c,
    oa.overall_average_percentage_c,
    (pc.percentage_c - oa.overall_average_percentage_c) AS difference_from_average
FROM 
    percentage_c pc,
    overall_average oa;

sql:
WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
),
MaxCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule_id,
        MAX(combination_count) AS max_combination_count
    FROM 
        ElementCombinations
    GROUP BY 
        molecule_id
),
MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        ec.molecule_id,
        ec.element1,
        ec.element2
    FROM 
        ElementCombinations ec
    JOIN 
        MaxCombinations mc ON ec.molecule_id = mc.molecule_id AND ec.combination_count = mc.max_combination_count
),
MostCommonCombinationBonds AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS most_common_combination_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond b
    JOIN 
        connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    JOIN 
        MostCommonCombinations mcc ON m.molecule_id = mcc.molecule_id AND a1.element = mcc.element1 AND a2.element = mcc.element2
),
TotalBonds AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS total_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond
)
SELECT 
    (most_common_combination_bond_count * 100.0 / total_bond_count) AS percentage
FROM 
    MostCommonCombinationBonds, TotalBonds;

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
c_percentages AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS c_percentage
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    LEFT JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(c_percentage) AS overall_average_c_percentage
    FROM 
        c_percentages
)
SELECT 
    cp.region,
    cp.loan_size_category,
    cp.c_percentage,
    oa.overall_average_c_percentage,
    (cp.c_percentage - oa.overall_average_c_percentage) AS difference_from_average
FROM 
    c_percentages cp,
    overall_average oa;
