sql:
WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    LEFT JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
    FROM 
        percentage_c
)
SELECT 
    pc.region,
    pc.loan_size_category,
    pc.percentage_c,
    oa.overall_average_percentage_c,
    (pc.percentage_c - oa.overall_average_percentage_c) AS difference_from_average
FROM 
    percentage_c pc,
    overall_average oa
ORDER BY 
    pc.region, pc.loan_size_category;

sql:
WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    LEFT JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
    FROM 
        percentage_c
)
SELECT 
    pc.region,
    pc.loan_size_category,
    pc.percentage_c,
    oa.overall_average_percentage_c,
    CASE 
        WHEN pc.percentage_c > oa.overall_average_percentage_c THEN 'Above Average'
        ELSE 'Below Average'
    END AS performance_comparison
FROM 
    percentage_c pc,
    overall_average oa;

sql:
WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    LEFT JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
    FROM 
        percentage_c
)
SELECT 
    pc.region,
    pc.loan_size_category,
    pc.percentage_c,
    oa.overall_average_percentage_c,
    CASE 
        WHEN pc.percentage_c > oa.overall_average_percentage_c THEN 'Above Average'
        ELSE 'Below Average'
    END AS performance_comparison
FROM 
    percentage_c pc,
    overall_average oa;

    ) s ON f."School Name" = s.School
    ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
    LIMIT 5
) s

sql:
WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    LEFT JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
    FROM 
        percentage_c
)
SELECT 
    pc.region,
    pc.loan_size_category,
    pc.percentage_c,
    oa.overall_average_percentage_c,
    CASE 
        WHEN pc.percentage_c > oa.overall_average_percentage_c THEN 'Above Average'
        ELSE 'Below Average'
    END AS performance_comparison
FROM 
    percentage_c pc,
    overall_average oa;

FROM (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,

        COUNT(*) AS combination_count
    FROM 
        connected c

    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id

    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element

        MAX(combination_count) AS max_combination_count

            a1.element AS element1,
            a2.element AS element2,
            COUNT(*) AS combination_count
        FROM 
            connected c

            atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id

SELECT 
    ac.region,
    ac.loan_size_category,
    (ac.c_count * 100.0 / ac.total_count) AS percentage_c,
    oa.overall_avg_percentage_c,
    (ac.c_count * 100.0 / ac.total_count) - oa.overall_avg_percentage_c AS difference_from_average
FROM (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c_count,
        COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, 
        CASE WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' ELSE 'Medium' END
) ac
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT 
        AVG((c_count * 100.0) / total_count) AS overall_avg_percentage_c
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            dist.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                ELSE 'Medium'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c_count,
            COUNT(*) AS total_count
        FROM 
            loan l
        JOIN 
            account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
        JOIN 
            district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
        WHERE 
            l.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            dist.A2, 
            CASE WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' ELSE 'Medium' END
    ) sub
    WHERE 
        sub.total_count > 0
) oa
WHERE 
    ac.total_count > 0
ORDER BY 
    ac.region, ac.loan_size_category;

    ec.element2,
    ec.combination_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element

JOIN (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        MAX(combination_count) AS max_combination_count
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            m.molecule_id,
            a1.element AS element1,
            a2.element AS element2,
            COUNT(*) AS combination_count
        FROM 
            connected c
        JOIN 
            atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
        JOIN 
            atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
        JOIN 
            molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
        WHERE 
            a1.element < a2.element
        GROUP BY

SELECT 
    ac.region,
    ac.loan_size_category,
    (ac.c_count * 100.0 / ac.total_count) AS percentage_c,
    oa.overall_avg_percentage_c,
    (ac.c_count * 100.0 / ac.total_count) - oa.overall_avg_percentage_c AS difference_from_average
FROM (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c_count,
        COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, 
        CASE WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' ELSE 'Medium' END
) ac
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT 
        AVG((c_count * 100.0) / total_count) AS overall_avg_percentage_c
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            dist.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                ELSE 'Medium'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c_count,
            COUNT(*) AS total_count
        FROM 
            loan l
        JOIN 
            account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
        JOIN 
            district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
        WHERE 
            l.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            dist.A2, 
            CASE WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' ELSE 'Medium' END
    ) sub
    WHERE 
        sub.total_count > 0
) oa
WHERE 
    ac.total_count > 0
ORDER BY 
    ac.region, ac.loan_size_category;

    g.Country,
    g.GasStationID
FROM 
    transactions_1k t
JOIN 
    gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE 
    t.Price < (
        SELECT

        WHERE 
            g2.Country = g.Country 
            AND g2.Segment = g.Segment 
            AND t2.ProductID = t.ProductID

GROUP BY 
    g.Country, g.GasStationID;

SELECT 
    ec.molecule_id,
    ec.element1,
    ec.element2,
    ec.combination_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
) ec
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        MAX(combination_count) AS max_combination_count
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            m.molecule_id,
            a1.element AS element1,
            a2.element AS element2,
            COUNT(*) AS combination_count
        FROM 
            connected c
        JOIN 
            atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
        JOIN 
            atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
        JOIN 
            molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
        WHERE 
            a1.element < a2.element
        GROUP BY 
            m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    ) sub
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id
) max_ec ON ec.molecule_id = max_ec.molecule_id AND ec.combination_count = max_ec.max_combination_count;

sql:
SELECT 
    ac.region,
    ac.loan_size_category,
    (ac.c_count * 100.0 / ac.total_count) AS percentage_c,
    oa.overall_avg_percentage_c,
    (ac.c_count * 100.0 / ac.total_count) - oa.overall_avg_percentage_c AS difference_from_average
FROM (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c_count,
        COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, 
        CASE WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' ELSE 'Medium' END
) ac
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT 
        AVG((c_count * 100.0) / total_count) AS overall_avg_percentage_c
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            dist.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                ELSE 'Medium'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c_count,
            COUNT(*) AS total_count
        FROM 
            loan l
        JOIN 
            account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
        JOIN 
            district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
        WHERE 
            l.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            dist.A2, 
            CASE WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' ELSE 'Medium' END
    ) sub
    WHERE 
        sub.total_count > 0
) oa
WHERE 
    ac.total_count > 0
ORDER BY 
    ac.region, ac.loan_size_category;

SELECT DISTINCT s1.sname, s1.AvgScrWrite, s1.CharterNum,
       COUNT(s2.AvgScrWrite) + 1 AS rank
FROM (
    SELECT s.sname, s.AvgScrWrite, sch.CharterNum
    FROM satscores s
    JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode
    WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND s.sname IS NOT NULL AND sch.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
) AS s1
JOIN (
    SELECT s.sname, s.AvgScrWrite
    FROM satscores s
    WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
) AS s2 ON s1.AvgScrWrite < s2.AvgScrWrite OR (s1.AvgScrWrite = s2.AvgScrWrite AND s1.sname >= s2.sname)
ORDER BY s1.AvgScrWrite DESC, s1.sname;

SELECT 
    ec.molecule_id,
    ec.element1,
    ec.element2,
    ec.combination_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
) ec
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        MAX(combination_count) AS max_combination_count
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            m.molecule_id,
            a1.element AS element1,
            a2.element AS element2,
            COUNT(*) AS combination_count
        FROM 
            connected c
        JOIN 
            atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
        JOIN 
            atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
        JOIN 
            molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
        WHERE 
            a1.element < a2.element
        GROUP BY 
            m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    ) sub
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id
) max_ec ON ec.molecule_id = max_ec.molecule_id AND ec.combination_count = max_ec.max_combination_count;

sql:
SELECT 
    ac.region,
    ac.loan_size_category,
    (ac.c_count * 100.0 / ac.total_count) AS percentage_c,
    oa.overall_avg_percentage_c,
    (ac.c_count * 100.0 / ac.total_count) - oa.overall_avg_percentage_c AS difference_from_average
FROM (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c_count,
        COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, 
        CASE WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' ELSE 'Medium' END
) ac
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT 
        AVG((c_count * 100.0) / total_count) AS overall_avg_percentage_c
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            dist.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                ELSE 'Medium'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c_count,
            COUNT(*) AS total_count
        FROM 
            loan l
        JOIN 
            account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
        JOIN 
            district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
        WHERE 
            l.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            dist.A2, 
            CASE WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' ELSE 'Medium' END
    ) sub
    WHERE 
        sub.total_count > 0
) oa
WHERE 
    ac.total_count > 0
ORDER BY 
    ac.region, ac.loan_size_category;

       ss.NumTstTakr, 
       ss.AvgScrRead, 
       ss.AvgScrMath, 
       ss.AvgScrWrite,

       (ss.NumTstTakr / f."Enrollment (K-12)") * 100 AS "SAT Participation Rate (%)",

FROM satscores ss

WHERE s."School" IN (
    SELECT "School Name"
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON f."School Name" = s."School"
    WHERE s.SOC = '66'
    ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
    LIMIT 5
);

sql:
WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    LEFT JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
    FROM 
        percentage_c
)
SELECT 
    pc.region,
    pc.loan_size_category,
    pc.percentage_c,
    oa.overall_average_percentage_c,
    (pc.percentage_c - oa.overall_average_percentage_c) AS difference_from_average
FROM 
    percentage_c pc,
    overall_average oa;

sql:
WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
),
MaxCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule_id,
        MAX(combination_count) AS max_combination_count
    FROM 
        ElementCombinations
    GROUP BY 
        molecule_id
),
MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        ec.molecule_id,
        ec.element1,
        ec.element2
    FROM 
        ElementCombinations ec
    JOIN 
        MaxCombinations mc ON ec.molecule_id = mc.molecule_id AND ec.combination_count = mc.max_combination_count
),
MostCommonCombinationBonds AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS most_common_combination_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond b
    JOIN 
        connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    JOIN 
        MostCommonCombinations mcc ON m.molecule_id = mcc.molecule_id AND a1.element = mcc.element1 AND a2.element = mcc.element2
),
TotalBonds AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS total_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond
)
SELECT 
    (most_common_combination_bond_count * 100.0 / total_bond_count) AS percentage
FROM 
    MostCommonCombinationBonds, TotalBonds;

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    LEFT JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
    FROM 
        percentage_c
)

    pc.region,
    pc.loan_size_category,
    pc.percentage_c,
    oa.overall_average_percentage_c,
    (pc.percentage_c - oa.overall_average_percentage_c) AS difference_from_average
FROM 
    percentage_c pc,
    overall_average oa
ORDER BY 
    pc.region, pc.loan_size_category;

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
),
percentage_c AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.region,
        tc.loan_size_category,
        COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
        tc.total_count,
        (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS percentage_c
    FROM 
        total_counts tc
    LEFT JOIN 
        status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage_c) AS overall_average_percentage_c
    FROM 
        percentage_c
)
SELECT 
    pc.region,
    pc.loan_size_category,
    pc.percentage_c,
    oa.overall_average_percentage_c,
    CASE 
        WHEN pc.percentage_c > oa.overall_average_percentage_c THEN 'Above Average'
        ELSE 'Below Average'
    END AS performance_comparison
FROM 
    percentage_c pc,
    overall_average oa;

SELECT s."School Code", 
       s."School Name", 
       s."FRPM Count (K-12)", 
       s."Enrollment (K-12)", 
       s."Eligibility Rate (%)",
       t.NumTstTakr, 
       t.AvgScrRead, 
       t.AvgScrMath, 
       t.AvgScrWrite, 
       t.NumGE1500,
       CASE WHEN t.NumTstTakr IS NOT NULL THEN (t.NumTstTakr / s."Enrollment (K-12)") * 100 ELSE NULL END AS "SAT Participation Rate (%)",
       CASE WHEN t.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL AND t.NumTstTakr IS NOT NULL THEN (t.NumGE1500 / t.NumTstTakr) * 100 ELSE NULL END AS "High Scorer Rate (%)"

    SELECT f."School Code", 
           f."School Name", 
           f."FRPM Count (K-12)", 
           f."Enrollment (K-12)",

    FROM frpm f
    JOIN (
        SELECT s.CDSCode, s.School
        FROM schools s
        WHERE s.SOC = '66'
    ) s ON f."School Name" = s.School
    ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
    LIMIT 5
) s
LEFT JOIN satscores t ON s."School Code" = t.cds;

SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    (c_count * 100.0 / total_count) AS percentage_c,
    overall_avg_percentage_c,
    (c_count * 100.0 / total_count) - overall_avg_percentage_c AS difference_from_average
FROM (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c_count,
        COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, 
        CASE WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' ELSE 'Medium' END
) AS loan_data
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT 
        AVG((c_count * 100.0) / total_count) AS overall_avg_percentage_c
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            dist.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                ELSE 'Medium'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c_count,
            COUNT(*) AS total_count
        FROM 
            loan l
        JOIN 
            account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
        JOIN 
            district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
        WHERE 
            l.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            dist.A2, 
            CASE WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' ELSE 'Medium' END
    ) AS sub_loan_data
    WHERE 
        sub_loan_data.total_count > 0
) AS overall_data
WHERE 
    loan_data.total_count > 0
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

SELECT 
    ec.molecule_id,
    ec.element1,
    ec.element2,
    ec.combination_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
) ec
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        sub.molecule_id,
        MAX(sub.combination_count) AS max_combination_count
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            m.molecule_id,
            a1.element AS element1,
            a2.element AS element2,
            COUNT(*) AS combination_count
        FROM 
            connected c
        JOIN 
            atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
        JOIN 
            atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
        JOIN 
            molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
        WHERE 
            a1.element < a2.element
        GROUP BY 
            m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    ) sub
    GROUP BY 
        sub.molecule_id
) max_ec ON ec.molecule_id = max_ec.molecule_id AND ec.combination_count = max_ec.max_combination_count;

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    (c_count * 100.0 / total_count) AS percentage_c,
    overall_avg_percentage_c,
    (c_count * 100.0 / total_count) - overall_avg_percentage_c AS difference_from_average
FROM (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c_count,
        COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, 
        CASE WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' ELSE 'Medium' END
) AS loan_data
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT 
        AVG((c_count * 100.0) / total_count) AS overall_avg_percentage_c
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            dist.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                ELSE 'Medium'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c_count,
            COUNT(*) AS total_count
        FROM 
            loan l
        JOIN 
            account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
        JOIN 
            district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
        WHERE 
            l.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            dist.A2, 
            CASE WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' ELSE 'Medium' END
    ) AS sub_loan_data
    WHERE 
        sub_loan_data.total_count > 0
) AS overall_data
WHERE 
    loan_data.total_count > 0
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

SELECT ANY_VALUE(s1.sname) AS sname, s1.AvgScrWrite, s1.CharterNum,
       COUNT(s2.AvgScrWrite) + 1 AS rank
FROM (
    SELECT s.sname, s.AvgScrWrite, sch.CharterNum
    FROM satscores s
    JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode
    WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND s.sname IS NOT NULL AND sch.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
) AS s1
JOIN (
    SELECT s.sname, s.AvgScrWrite
    FROM satscores s
    WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
) AS s2 ON s1.AvgScrWrite < s2.AvgScrWrite OR (s1.AvgScrWrite = s2.AvgScrWrite AND s1.sname >= s2.sname)
GROUP BY s1.AvgScrWrite, s1.CharterNum
ORDER BY s1.AvgScrWrite DESC, s1.sname;

SELECT 
    ec.molecule_id,
    ec.element1,
    ec.element2,
    ec.combination_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
) ec
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        sub.molecule_id,
        MAX(sub.combination_count) AS max_combination_count
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            m.molecule_id,
            a1.element AS element1,
            a2.element AS element2,
            COUNT(*) AS combination_count
        FROM 
            connected c
        JOIN 
            atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
        JOIN 
            atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
        JOIN 
            molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
        WHERE 
            a1.element < a2.element
        GROUP BY 
            m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    ) sub
    GROUP BY 
        sub.molecule_id
) max_ec ON ec.molecule_id = max_ec.molecule_id AND ec.combination_count = max_ec.max_combination_count;

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    (c_count * 100.0 / total_count) AS percentage_c,
    overall_avg_percentage_c,
    (c_count * 100.0 / total_count) - overall_avg_percentage_c AS difference_from_average
FROM (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c_count,
        COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, 
        CASE WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' ELSE 'Medium' END
) AS loan_data
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT 
        AVG((c_count * 100.0) / total_count) AS overall_avg_percentage_c
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            dist.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                ELSE 'Medium'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c_count,
            COUNT(*) AS total_count
        FROM 
            loan l
        JOIN 
            account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
        JOIN 
            district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
        WHERE 
            l.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            dist.A2, 
            CASE WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' ELSE 'Medium' END
    ) AS sub_loan_data
    WHERE 
        sub_loan_data.total_count > 0
) AS overall_data
WHERE 
    loan_data.total_count > 0
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

SELECT 
    ec.molecule_id,
    ec.element1,
    ec.element2,
    ec.combination_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
) ec
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        sub.molecule_id,
        MAX(sub.combination_count) AS max_combination_count
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            m.molecule_id,
            a1.element AS element1,
            a2.element AS element2,
            COUNT(*) AS combination_count
        FROM 
            connected c
        JOIN 
            atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
        JOIN 
            atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
        JOIN 
            molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
        WHERE 
            a1.element < a2.element
        GROUP BY 
            m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    ) sub
    GROUP BY 
        sub.molecule_id
) max_ec ON ec.molecule_id = max_ec.molecule_id AND ec.combination_count = max_ec.max_combination_count;

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    (c_count * 100.0 / total_count) AS percentage_c,
    overall_avg_percentage_c,
    (c_count * 100.0 / total_count) - overall_avg_percentage_c AS difference_from_average
FROM (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c_count,
        COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, 
        CASE WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' ELSE 'Medium' END
) AS loan_data
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT 
        AVG((c_count * 100.0) / total_count) AS overall_avg_percentage_c
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            dist.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                ELSE 'Medium'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c_count,
            COUNT(*) AS total_count
        FROM 
            loan l
        JOIN 
            account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
        JOIN 
            district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
        WHERE 
            l.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            dist.A2, 
            CASE WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' ELSE 'Medium' END
    ) AS sub_loan_data
    WHERE 
        sub_loan_data.total_count > 0
) AS overall_data
WHERE 
    loan_data.total_count > 0
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
